title: the bash superclaude is retired: its callers and proofs move to superclaude.py and the retire door deletes it
intention: cairn/devices/cc/superclaude (the bash) no longer exists: nothing runs it, every proof that ran it measures superclaude.py, and `cairn codemother retire` deleted it with no caller named.
why: Child 6 of c3cd232ba0cf; outline 10.3.2.1 says superclaude is Python on every box. Measured 2026-11-23 at origin/main ee12953c6: the retire machine's namers() lists 20 files naming the bash; children 1941e93b25a3 (the port) and 0b7a3f1d53f0 (bin/cairn dispatch) are PROVED, so bin/cairn no longer starts the bash on any box, and two launchers beside each other drift.
traces_to: Law 1 (a settled answer is not re-derived: two launchers is two answers); Law 4 (the retire door finds the callers by running proofs); outline 10.3.2.1.
how: Repoint the two callers; repoint or retire each bash-running proof (mapping in the decisions); write one proof that the bash is gone and nothing names it as live; run `cairn codemother retire cairn/devices/cc/superclaude` on Linux; fix the wording of the charters and comments. The build is a Linux hand's, in that order.

clauses.claim: cc/0/bin/restart and recovery/bootstrap.sh name cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py and no longer name the bash path

each proof that ran the bash reads green against superclaude.py (sets_cairn_user, wire, memory_scope, tmux_mode launcher teeth, test_bootstrap launch teeth, ground_loop_survives_its_caller, the unit-of-a-run proof, launchers_moved, the floor-link and instance-wiring proofs, the cairn device launcher, the learning_block holder tooth), and test_superclaude_bare_box.py is retired with its teeth named
`cairn codemother retire cairn/devices/cc/superclaude` exits RETIRED on Linux with no CALLER and the file is absent
no charter, outline piece or comment under cairn/ names the bash path as a live launcher

decisions.text: D1: repoint the two callers. cairn/devices/cc/0/bin/restart:55 sets LAUNCHER to cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py (run through the venv python, as bin/cairn does); recovery/bootstrap.sh:484-485 (cairn_wire_instances) links superclaude.py as the verb superclaude, the way bin/cairn.py _wire_instances already does.

D2: repoint the cc proofs to superclaude.py. sets_cairn_user (5 teeth), wire (3), the three launcher teeth of tmux_mode (lines 159-177; its other nine do not touch the bash) and memory_scope's in-situ pty arm keep their teeth with the launcher path set to the .py; the replacement for the dry-run semantics is tooth 1 of test_superclaude_runs_from_python, for the memory scope tooth 8. A tooth the .py cannot satisfy is a FIXME to the builder, never a weakening.

D3: repoint the other proofs that run or read the bash: test_bootstrap (its two launch teeth, 222 and 236), test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller, test_a_unit_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs, test_launchers_moved_to_their_devices (its tooth_scripts_parse_and_locate and tooth_no_live_reference move to the .py), bin's floor-link and instance-wiring proofs (the verb link now targets the .py), the cairn device's launcher proof, and the learning_block holder tooth (line 142 reads the bash for `--holder`; it reads the .py for its trace call). The held-instance proof test_a_launch_moves_off_a_held_instance.py is NOT here: ticket b33cc7d29c45 owns it.

D4: retire test_superclaude_bare_box.py whole (4 teeth: askpass serves only what is held, a held password is guidance never text, an absent claude would be installed, no password never hangs). Replacement: tooth 7 of test_superclaude_runs_from_python (no sudo, no password prompt, never elevates) covers the first two and the last as their absence. NO REPLACEMENT: 'an absent claude would be installed'; superclaude.py does not install claude, so it is named dropped here, and the builder reports it to the orchestrator rather than adding an installer to the .py.

D5: one new proof, one tooth per falsifier clause 1, 3 and 4 (red first): the two callers name the .py; the bash path is absent from the tree; no live file names it as a launcher. Clause 2 is the repointed proofs' own seals. Then run `cairn codemother retire cairn/devices/cc/superclaude` on Linux, which deletes the bash when no caller turns red.

D6: fix the wording that names the bash as the launcher: the cc, recovery and launch charters, outline piece 05-cairn-device.md, the shim and probe comments, and the docstrings of the three proofs that only mention it.

measured.saw: namers() of the retire machine over cairn/devices/cc/superclaude at origin/main ee12953c6 returns 20 files: text-only charters and comments, 2 callers (cc/0/bin/restart:55, recovery/bootstrap.sh:484), and 13 proofs of which 12 run or read the bash; the bash still stands beside the .py.
measured.how: python over cairn.devices.codemother.machines.retire.retire.namers on akiendell, then a grep of each namer for the path without .py

measured.saw: tickets 1941e93b25a3 and 0b7a3f1d53f0 read [PROVED]; test_superclaude_runs_from_python.py holds 9 teeth (dry-run, held instance, preflight, services, restart loop, console spawn, no OS tests or elevation, memory scope, charter invoke line); test_superclaude_bare_box.py holds 4 teeth about sudo askpass and installing claude.
measured.how: read the ticket states in CairnCommons/tickets and the test_ functions of the two proof files
